mapper.select: select proofread.*, a.NAME as prjName, e.NAME as stageName, b.NAME as subItemName, f.NAME as professionName, u.NAME as createUserName, h.NAME as fileName, h.OLD_F_ID as oldFId from BIZ_CAD_PROOFREAD proofread left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a on a.ID = proofread.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.ID = proofread.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = proofread.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = proofread.PROFESSION_ID left join BIZ_CAD_USER u on u.ID = proofread.CREATE_USER left join BIZ_CAD_STORAGE h on h.ID = proofread.STORAGE_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
